contradictions.scenario: A constraints run samples one of the seeded known clashes and the model lists it as a contradiction. SR-002.1 makes it block in a constraints record, and SR-002.2's stop rule counts it as a contradiction. SR-002.3 says seeded items don't count for check or the stop rule. Nothing says how the script tells seeded entries from others.
contradictions.smallest_change: In SR-002.3, say seeded entries are matched by fixed ids in the record and filtered out before check and the stop count. Alternatively, drop 'don't count' and let them block like any other contradiction.

requirements: One release path, checked by code
contradictions.scenario: A clean review has coverage 'unavailable'. The owner records his exception in his words at the head before the merge, and the merge happens. Coverage is mandatory says this counts as a passing review for record-release. One release path says a merge with no passing review stays merged_unreviewed and 'carries the owner's exception in his words'.
contradictions.smallest_change: State in One release path that a recorded coverage exception makes the review passing, so the item goes to released. Reserve merged_unreviewed for merges with no clean review at the head.
